_HOW_TO_EDIT: This is the ONE file to update as the campaign evolves. No coding needed: edit text between quotes, save, push. Every section below is labelled. Empty string "" = feature hidden on the site. When FRD announces her candidacy, change mode from 'personal' to 'campaign' and the homepage switches to campaign mode automatically.

analytics._help: Free visitor stats. Create account at goatcounter.com (2 min), pick a code like 'frdantuono', paste it below. Leave empty = no analytics.

newsletter._help: Signups currently go to Netlify Forms (see dashboard > Forms > newsletter). When you create the free Brevo account, paste the Brevo form URL below and the box switches automatically. Instructions in LAUNCH_CHECKLIST.md.

video._help: A short 'who I am' video for the homepage. Paste the YouTube ID (the part after v= in the URL). Empty = section hidden.

title.en: Who I am, in two minutes

campaignMode._help: Used ONLY when mode='campaign'. The homepage hero swaps to this message. PLACEHOLDER — to be written with FRD before the announcement.
